text: This report recommends that the name "Louis Kesten Lane" be approved to identify a public lane south of Queen Street East, extending between Booth Avenue and Logan Avenue. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Louis Kesten Lane" for a public lane south of Queen Street East, extending between Booth Avenue and Logan Avenue.
